svg.aria-label: Codebase Copilot: Parses a repo into a code graph and answers questions with hybrid retrieval (pgvector + full-text, RRF) and cited sources. Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Fastify, pgvector, Redis, BullMQ, tree-sitter.
